name: core-1-og-onyx
description: Summarize, compare and visualize Aethera reports with the preserved Onyx engine; explore Praying Mantis synthetic planning through a separate local companion.

interface.longDescription: A focused skills-only package containing the unchanged original OnyxCore with its bounded Node.js adapter and offline visual reports, plus a separately named Praying Mantis planning companion requiring Python 3.10+ for its CLI. Onyx summarizes five supported Aethera schemas, compares reports, and returns fixed next-test advice. Mantis offers inert fixture matching, synthetic firewall classification and syntax-only VPN plans, with enforcement disabled. It is not live antivirus, a host firewall or a VPN client. Reports remain unverified. Includes synthetic examples and tests; no hosted service, account connection, model training or broader Onyx Foundation modules. Preparation does not establish installed-host compatibility or public-directory availability.
defaultPrompt: Use Core 1 - OG Onyx to compare and visualize these two JSON reports.
Summarize this Aethera report with the original Onyx core.
Create the included synthetic visual showcase.
Run the Praying Mantis companion’s inert fixture example and explain its limits.
